questions.s: As per the 2016 report on Global Trafficking in Persons published by UN Office on Drugs & Crime, Victims and Traffickers often have
questions.x: UNODC's 2016 Global Report on Trafficking in Persons found that victims and traffickers often share the same ethnic background or citizenship.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which Indian shooter won a Gold medal at the ISSF World Cup Rifle/Pistol/Shotgun held in New Delhi ?
questions.x: Jitu Rai won gold in the 10 m air pistol at the ISSF World Cup in New Delhi in 2017.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: As per the 4th National Family Health Survey, how many females are there in the State of Andhra Pradesh per 1000 males ?
questions.x: NFHS-4 (2015-16) reported a sex ratio of 1,020 females per 1,000 males for Andhra Pradesh's total population.
questions.subject: Indian Society

questions.s: For which of the following reasons was the FCRA license of Public Health Federation of India recently cancelled by the Government of India ?
questions.x: The Home Ministry cancelled PHFI's FCRA registration in 2017 for using foreign contributions to lobby parliamentarians on tobacco control laws.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: What is the percentage of votes polled in the recent By-elections to the Srinagar Lok Sabha Constituency ?
questions.x: The April 2017 Srinagar Lok Sabha by-election recorded a historic low turnout of about 7.14%.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Who was responsible for the gaffe in announcing the name of the Best Film at the 2017 Oscar Awards Ceremony ?
questions.x: The 2017 Oscars Best Picture mix-up was caused by accountancy firm PricewaterhouseCoopers handing the wrong envelope to the presenters.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: “Every Indian is special. Every Indian is a VIP.” On which occasion did Prime Minister Narendra Modi tweeted these words ?
o: On abolition of red beacons on vehicles of dignitaries
questions.x: PM Modi tweeted 'Every Indian is special. Every Indian is a VIP' when the Cabinet ended the use of red beacons on dignitaries' vehicles (April 2017).
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which of the following politicians completed 50 years as Legislator in March, 2017 ?
questions.x: Kerala's K.M. Mani completed 50 years as a legislator from Pala in March 2017.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Upon reorganization of the State, Andhra Pradesh had a higher public debt than Telangana because
o: Andhra Pradesh is bigger than Telangana in area
Andhra Pradesh had more assets and hence more debt
Population ratio was the sole factor for distribution of debt
Union Government decided that Andhra Pradesh has to bear more debt
questions.x: Under the AP Reorganisation Act, debts not tied to specific assets were apportioned on population ratio (58.32:41.68), so the larger-population AP got more debt.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What is the amount of special assistance provided by the Central Government to Andhra Pradesh in 2016 – 17 ?
questions.x: The Centre released about Rs 1,976.50 crore as special assistance to Andhra Pradesh in 2016-17.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: As per Andhra Pradesh retail trade policy 2015 – 20, how many additional employment opportunities would be created in the retail sector by 2020 ?
questions.x: The AP Retail Trade Policy 2015-20 aimed to create 20,000 additional jobs in the retail sector by 2020.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: What was the percentage of debt outstanding to GSDP of Andhra Pradesh in 2014 – 15 after reorganization of the State of Andhra Pradesh ?
questions.x: After bifurcation, AP's outstanding debt was put at about 28.19% of GSDP in 2014-15.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Which of the following was mostly used to facilitate long distance communication by the inhabitants of Harappan Civilization ?
questions.x: Harappan seals and sealings, stamped on goods and packages, were used to communicate over long distances, e.g. to mark ownership in trade.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: The earliest inscriptions found in India were written in
questions.x: The earliest deciphered inscriptions of India, Ashoka's edicts, were mostly in Prakrit in the Brahmi script.
questions.subject: History

questions.s:
Match the following travellers with their countries of origin :
A. Al-Biruni
B. Ibn Battuta
C. Mahmud Wali Balkhi
D. Seydi Ali Reis
I. Afghanistan
II. Turkey
III. Morocco
IV. Uzbekistan
questions.x: Al-Biruni came from Khwarizm (Uzbekistan), Ibn Battuta from Morocco, Mahmud Wali Balkhi from Balkh (Afghanistan) and Seydi Ali Reis from Turkey: A-IV, B-III, C-I, D-II.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Which system of transport was often used by the Delhi Sultanate to transport fruits of Khorasan to India ?
questions.x: APPSC keyed the horse-post (uluq). Note that Ibn Battuta's account (NCERT) ties fruit from Khurasan to the foot-post (dawa), so this key is debatable.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Which of the following Sufi saints was known as Garib Nawaz ?
questions.x: Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti of Ajmer is popularly called Garib Nawaz, 'benefactor of the poor'.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: What was the practice adopted by the Vijayanagar Kings to protect the inhabitants within a fortified area from starvation due to sieges by enemy armies ?
o: Large granaries were built within the fortified area to store grains
Secret pathways were maintained to transport groceries into fortified areas
Large agricultural tracts were incorporated within the fortified area
The forts were built on hills to prevent siege by the enemy
questions.x: Vijayanagara fortifications enclosed agricultural tracts so that the city could grow its own food during long sieges.
questions.subject: History

questions.s:
Arrange the names of the following freedom fighters in ascending order of the period of the rebellion by them :
I. Vasudev Balwant Phadke
II. Khudiram Bose
III. Alluri Sitarama Raju
IV. Kanhu Murmu
questions.x: Kanhu Murmu led the Santhal rebellion (1855), followed by Phadke (1879), Khudiram Bose (1908) and Alluri (1922-24). APPSC keyed IV, I, III, II, although strict chronology would put II before III, so this key is debatable.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Having failed to control the Paharias, the British invited the following to cultivate the land in the Rajmahal Hills :
questions.x: Unable to subdue the Paharias, the British invited the Santhals to settle and cultivate the Rajmahal Hills (Damin-i-koh).
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Which of the following is one of the reasons for Mahatma Gandhi to use salt as a symbol of protest ?
o: Dandi sea shore which was full of salt was nearer to his Ashram
Salt was not given due importance by the British
The government was depriving Indians of even nature made salt by wanton destruction of salt
questions.x: Gandhi chose salt because the government taxed it and even destroyed naturally formed salt it could not tax, depriving Indians of a basic, nature-given item.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: What is the title of the book published in 1958 containing the edited collection of letters written to and by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru ?
o: I and Mahatma – A collection of letters
In the eyes of the World
questions.x: 'A Bunch of Old Letters' (1958) is Nehru's edited collection of letters written to and by him.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Which of the following is one of the salient features of the Lucknow Pact, 1916 ?
o: The Congress and Muslim League would share power in Legislative Councils
The Congress accepted the system of separate electorates based on religion
The Congress and Muslim League would fight for complete independence
A working committee was established by the Congress to run day to day affairs
questions.x: In the 1916 Lucknow Pact the Congress accepted separate electorates for Muslims in exchange for joint pressure on the British.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Which of the following evidences support the Big Bang Theory on the origin of the Universe ?
o: Maintenance of steady state by the Universe
questions.x: The observed expansion of the universe (Hubble's red shift) supports the Big Bang theory.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following is a direct source of information about the interior of the Earth ?
questions.x: Surface rock from mining areas is a direct source of information about the earth's interior; seismic, gravity and magnetic studies are indirect sources.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Till, moraine and boulder clay are depositional land forms due to
questions.x: Till, moraine and boulder clay are deposited by glaciers.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Out of the below, identify the process which is not part of the hydrological cycle.
questions.x: Evaporation, condensation and precipitation are parts of the hydrological cycle; hydration is a chemical weathering process.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which is the largest tributary of the Godavari in terms of coverage of drainage area ?
questions.x: The Pranhita (formed by the Wardha, Wainganga and Penganga) has the largest drainage area among Godavari tributaries.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: As per reliable estimates, which of the following locations in India has the largest shale gas reserves compared to others ?
questions.x: Estimates rank the Cambay Basin in Gujarat as having the largest shale gas reserves in India.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Under the Hydrocarbon Exploration Licensing Policy (HELP), the revenue to the Government of India accrues through
questions.x: HELP (2016) replaced production sharing with a biddable revenue-sharing contract model.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: In which of the following places of Andhra Pradesh are Karst topography features seen ?
questions.x: The Belum Caves in Kurnool district are formed in limestone and show classic karst features.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following could be the most important factor in decline of slate industry in Markapur ?
o: Non availability of slate in the mines
Non availability of labour for quarrying
questions.x: Markapur slates were mainly used as writing slates; demand fell as users switched to paper and notebooks.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: In which part of Andhra Pradesh are a major portion of Uranium reserves located ?
questions.x: Most of Andhra Pradesh's uranium, including the Tummalapalle deposit, lies in the Cuddapah (Kadapa) Basin.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following is not a criterion for acquiring citizenship of India, subject to other conditions ?
questions.x: The Citizenship Act, 1955 provides citizenship by birth, descent, registration, naturalisation and incorporation of territory; ethnic identity is not a criterion.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: The Constituent Assembly was composed roughly on the lines suggested by
questions.x: The Constituent Assembly was formed in 1946 on the lines of the Cabinet Mission Plan.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Which of the following may be a violation of fundamental rights ?
o: Not allowing loudspeakers in a religious procession
questions.x: Paying less than the minimum wage amounts to forced labour under Article 23 (PUDR case), so it violates a fundamental right.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: In which election in India was VVPAT used for the first time on experimental basis ?
questions.x: VVPAT was first used on a trial basis in the 2013 by-election to the Noksen Assembly seat in Nagaland.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Which of the following is a “pocket veto” power in the Indian context ?
o: Speaker of Lok Sabha not allowing presentation of a bill
President keeping a bill pending with him, without any time limit and without approving
Prime Minister removing ministers from his Cabinet without any reason
Rajya Sabha vetoing the provisions of a bill approved by Lok Sabha
questions.x: Under Article 111 the President can keep a bill pending indefinitely without assent or return, which is called a pocket veto.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: The mission of the Government of India for electronic delivery of all Government services is known as
questions.x: e-Kranti (Digital India pillar) aims at electronic delivery of all government services.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: The one stop e-market place established by the Government of India for procurement of goods and services by government organizations and PSUs is named as
questions.x: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM) is the one-stop online platform for public procurement of goods and services.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: As per the data available in the National Judicial Data Grid in April, 2017, what is the approximate percentage of cases in Indian Courts pending for more than two years ?
questions.x: APPSC keyed about 65% of cases in Indian courts pending for over two years, as per the NJDG in April 2017.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: In which of the following issues did the Supreme Court invoke Article 142 of the Constitution to issue directions in a judgment in a case in 2016 ?
o: Right of disabled people to live with dignity
Ban on licenses to liquor shops near State and National Highways
questions.x: In State of Tamil Nadu v. K. Balu (2016) the Supreme Court used Article 142 to ban liquor shops within 500 m of national and state highways.
questions.subject: Polity
